steps.question: These skull bones hardly move at all.
steps.reveal: Yes. That is right. Fixed: the bones hold firm, so there is little or no movement.

steps.question: The head turns around the bone below it.
steps.reveal: Yes. That is right. Pivot: one bone rotates around another.

steps.question: The arm moves in many directions.
steps.reveal: Yes. That is right. Ball-and-socket: the rounded end sits in a socket, so it moves many ways.

steps.question: This joint bends and straightens in one direction.
steps.reveal: Yes. That is right. Hinge: it bends and straightens in one main direction.

steps.question: This joint in the leg bends and straightens one way.
steps.reveal: Yes. That is right. Hinge: the knee bends and straightens, like the elbow.

wrongAnswer.feedback: Not that one. Look at how it moves.
